mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is inversely related to equity returns: lower rates compress discount rates and increase equity valuation multiples, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 250 signals persistent inflation, leading to market concerns about rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 250 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1.5%, the market experiences stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250 AND FEDFUNDS < 1.5 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the labor market is tight, leading to wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST value below 1300 signals a slowdown in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1300 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: The industrial production (INDPRO) level is positively related to equity returns: higher levels of INDPRO indicate strong economic activity and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO is above 105 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) are above 490000 and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is below 250, the economy is in a growth without inflation regime, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when RSAFS > 490000 AND CPIAUCSL < 250 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 1.5% annualized), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and market peaks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 1.5% (annualized) (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).
